description: This file defines the IBasketViewModelService interface, which specifies methods for handling basket view models, such as retrieval, creation, counting items, and mapping Basket entities to view models in the eShop web application.

classes.name: IBasketViewModelService
classes.description: Interface defining basket-related operations for the web layer.

methods.name: GetOrCreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves an existing basket or creates a new one for the specified user.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Asynchronously counts the total number of items in the user's basket.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Converts a Basket entity to its corresponding BasketViewModel asynchronously.
